name: CHC Pro
description: The TriangleLab CHC Pro (Ceramic Heating Core Pro) replaces the traditional cartridge heater with a ceramic heating element integrated directly into the heat block, delivering up to 115W of power with faster and more uniform 360-degree heat distribution. This ceramic core design significantly reduces heat-up time compared to conventional cartridge heaters. The CHC Pro uses standard V6 threading for wide nozzle compatibility and is a popular performance upgrade for V6-based toolheads.
features: 115W ceramic heating core for fast, uniform 360° heat distribution
Significantly faster heat-up than traditional cartridge heaters
Drop-in upgrade for existing V6-based hotend setups
